name: Fermented Soda
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ⅛ tsp (0.625 ml) champagne yeast or 2 tsp (10 ml) kefir grains

steps: Sterilize all your equipment before beginning.
Combine all of the ingredients in a container suitable for fermentation. Note that gas will be produced during the fermentation.
Put the container in a warm place, and allow it to ferment for 3 days.
If desired, strain the finished product. Store in the fridge.
